transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Um, I'm here because lately I just can't seem to keep my head clear at work. It's becoming a real problem. 

I'll lose track of what my clients are saying right in the middle of listening to them, or I'll sit there and reread the same chart note over and over. I just... I keep freezing up on really simple decisions that I used to handle without any issue.
Have you noticed these difficulties with concentration and decision-making for most of your life, or is this a relatively new change for you?

No, this is definitely a new change. Um, I'd say it's been going on for about a month now. 

It started right around the time our clinic lost some staff. Because we were short-handed, my schedule got shifted into late-evening coverage, and I've had to take on a lot heavier crisis paperwork. That's really when I started noticing that I couldn't focus or make decisions like I used to. Before this last month, I didn't have any issues like this.
Beyond the difficulty focusing at work, have you been feeling significantly sad, down, or have you lost interest in the activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I definitely have. Um, mostly I've just completely lost interest in things I usually like doing. 

My guitar has just been sitting in the corner gathering dust lately. I keep bailing on playing soccer, and I've been skipping my shifts at the shelter, too. Even when I actually force myself to try to do something, like cook a decent meal or go hiking, it just feels like I'm going through the motions with no real point to it. I just don't get anything out of it anymore.
Do you feel that your current low mood and loss of interest are directly tied to the recent changes and increased pressure at your workplace?

I'm honestly not sure. I mean... work is definitely a lot more stressful right now with the schedule and the paperwork, but I don't know if that's the actual reason I feel this way. 

It kind of feels like, even when I have a day off and I'm not thinking about the clinic at all, that total lack of interest is still just... there. So I guess I really can't say for sure if it's directly tied to the job pressure or not.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or overall energy levels since these feelings started?

Yeah, my sleep has definitely changed. Um... I get home from work feeling really tired, but then I just lie there in bed for hours. I just keep replaying the day in my head. And then, if I do actually manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up way before my alarm. It just feels like I barely slept at all by the time I have to get up.
Have you noticed a significant change in your appetite or your weight since these feelings started?

Yeah, my appetite has definitely dropped. Most days I just don't feel hungry at all until someone actually reminds me to eat. I've been skipping meals without really meaning to, honestly. And because of that, I guess I've lost some weight, since I've noticed my pants have gotten pretty loose on me lately.
Do you feel like your body is moving or speaking much more slowly than usual, or conversely, do you feel an intense, restless need to be constantly moving?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm moving or talking slower than normal, and I don't feel restless or like I need to keep moving around, either. I'm just... tired. But my actual movements seem pretty much the same as always.
Do you find yourself feeling excessively guilty about things, or do you feel like you are a failure or a burden to others?

Yeah, I do feel like that a lot lately. Um... especially at work. Like, if I miss just one little detail in a note, or if I forget to return a call right away, I just... I keep telling myself that I'm useless. It really feels like I'm completely letting the clients down, and honestly everyone else at the clinic, too. I just beat myself up over every little thing.
Have you been having any thoughts that life is not worth living or that you would be better off dead?

Yeah, I have. I mean, I don't have an actual plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But I do keep having these thoughts... like it would just be easier if I went to sleep and didn't wake up. And honestly, having thoughts like that scares me, especially with my job, because I know exactly what that can mean.
